scripts.check: turbo run typecheck test && tsc -p e2e && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:compute && pnpm run lint:compute
scripts.lint:compute: cd apps/compute && uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run --locked ruff format --check . && uv run --locked pyright
scripts.synth: cd apps/compute && uv run --locked python -m tributary_compute.synth
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && cd apps/compute && uv sync --frozen
scripts.gen:python: cd apps/compute && rm -rf tributary_compute/contracts && uv run --locked datamodel-codegen --input ../../packages/contracts/generated/json-schema --input-file-type jsonschema --output tributary_compute/contracts --output-model-type pydantic_v2.BaseModel --target-python-version 3.12 --disable-timestamp --field-constraints --use-annotated --use-standard-collections --use-union-operator --enum-field-as-literal all --formatters ruff-format
